tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Use this first whenever the user asks to find, search for, buy or rent something locally (e.g. 'תחפש לי', 'תמצא לי', 'אני מחפש לקנות'): second-hand items, vehicles, apartments, jobs, professionals, pets or events. Searches active Community Board listings. Filter by words in the title or description,

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Use this when the user wants more details about a listing returned by a search. Retrieves one listing by its UUID. Active listings are visible to everyone. Draft, sold, closed, or expired listings are returned only to their owner when the local development identity is configured; otherwise they are

tools.name: search_nearby
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what is available, sold or happening near a place or near them (e.g. 'מה מוכרים לידי', 'מה קורה לידי', 'איש מקצוע באזור'). If their location is unknown, ask for a city or area first instead of guessing. Finds active listings near a geographic point using PostGIS distance

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Use this to map what the user wants (e.g. car, apartment, plumber, job, dog, event) to a category slug before searching. Returns the category slugs and display names accepted by listing creation and search. Use a returned slug as the category parameter. An empty categories array means no categories
